soal_07_stimulus_01.png.description: Product-label design on a sage-green textured background. Top: large brush-script text "Jamoe Si Mbok". Centre-left: a framed photo of a glass mug of orange-yellow drink with turmeric roots, cinnamon sticks, star anise and a small bowl of turmeric powder, on a taped paper backdrop with pressed flowers and a fern sprig as decoration. Right: the text "Varian" and, on a torn-paper strip, "BERAS KENCUR". Bottom left: "Komposisi" (bold) and "Beras, Kencur, Gula Jawa". Bottom right: "300 ml" and "Baik dikonsumsi sebelum: 15 Mei  2026" (two spaces between "Mei" and "2026" as printed).
